name: National Library of Chile
scope: The standing Biblioteca Nacional de Chile and its Alameda facade, with the domed central entrance, two pavilion roofs, long side and rear elevations and three mapped light wells.
era: Present standing Biblioteca Nacional at Alameda 651, with its as-built footprint, using early author-published and federal photographic evidence for surviving facade elements.

originalReview.notes: Exact original federal archive JPEG already published by Qualla. The oblique Alameda view resolves the three-part front, broad order, corner pavilion and mansards. The architecture independently matches the photograph printed by its architect in 1924.

review.method: Qualla original matched to native Commons original and federal archive attribution
review.notes: Started with the exact federal archive original already published on the Qualla story. Commons binds the Bureau of Public Roads attribution, public-domain release, NARA accession and identical original bytes. Newspaper, interiors, unrelated gallery photos and modern CC BY/SA photographs are outside the selected architectural references.
